import os,json,stat,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
pairs=[
('/etc/fadego-staging/app.env','/srv/projects/fadego/private/systemd-env/app.env'),
('/etc/fadego-staging/send-closed.env','/srv/projects/fadego/private/systemd-env/send-closed.env'),
('/etc/pink-iptv/backend.env','/srv/projects/pink-iptv/private/systemd-env/backend.env'),
('/etc/pink-iptv/secrets.env','/srv/projects/pink-iptv/private/systemd-env/secrets.env'),
('/etc/pink-iptv/vpn.env','/srv/projects/pink-iptv/private/systemd-env/vpn.env')]
out={'operation':'stage_project_private_systemd_environment','phase':'copy_and_verify_only','created_files':0,'source_files_unchanged':True,'central_vault_untouched':True,'status':'PRECHECK'}
created=[];dirs=[]
try:
 assert os.geteuid()==0
 for name in ('fadego','pink-iptv'):
  root=Path('/srv/projects')/name
  assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
  p=root/'private'
  assert not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink(),'existing private directory requires separate audit'
  q=p/'systemd-env'
  assert not q.exists() and not q.is_symlink()
 for raw,d in pairs:
  src=Path(raw);dst=Path(d)
  assert src.is_file() and not src.is_symlink()
  st=src.stat()
  assert st.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) in (0o600,0o640) and 0<st.st_size<10000
  assert not dst.exists() and not dst.is_symlink()
 for name in ('fadego','pink-iptv'):
  root=Path('/srv/projects')/name
  p=root/'private';p.mkdir(mode=0o700);dirs.append(p)
  q=p/'systemd-env';q.mkdir(mode=0o700);dirs.append(q)
 for raw,d in pairs:
  src=Path(raw);dst=Path(d);st=src.stat()
  fd=os.open(dst,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
  created.append(dst)
  with open(src,'rb') as rd,os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as wr:
   shutil.copyfileobj(rd,wr);wr.flush();os.fsync(wr.fileno())
  os.fchown(os.open(dst,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW),st.st_uid,st.st_gid) if False else None
  os.chown(dst,st.st_uid,st.st_gid)
  os.chmod(dst,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode))
  assert src.read_bytes()==dst.read_bytes(),'content mismatch'
  assert stat.S_IMODE(dst.stat().st_mode)==stat.S_IMODE(src.stat().st_mode)
 out.update({'status':'COPIED_AND_VERIFIED','created_files':len(created),'paths':[str(x) for x in created]})
except Exception as e:
 out.update({'status':'FAILED_NO_SERVICE_CHANGE','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:150]})
 for p in reversed(created):
  try:p.unlink()
  except OSError:pass
 for d in reversed(dirs):
  try:d.rmdir()
  except OSError:pass
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
